semantics.days: Completed UTC calendar days only; current incomplete day shown separately.
semantics.progress: Elapsed simulated time, not fraction of trade rows.
semantics.retention: Full-fill count / original ordinary exits at SAME inclusive canonical event; productivity ratio, not mapped survivor identities.
semantics.orders: Normal BUY/SELL submitted orders only; full/partial-only/zero-fill cohorts; zero-fill includes pending/rejected/canceled.
semantics.releases: Attempted counts B10 release signals; IOC order attempts are separate. Blocked counts INSUFFICIENT_RESERVE predicate evaluations.
semantics.loss_bps: Executed lot cost denominator, never clamped at 10bps.
semantics.pnl: Realized settled PnL plus realized partial sales in open lot; excludes unsold inventory mark and internal reserve transfers.
semantics.max_hold_and_lock: Hours; includes ongoing position through checkpoint T. Lock is sum of holding hours beyond24h.

unavailable_until.slippage_cost: Independent spread/latency/slippage decomposition from historical execution evidence; current envelope embeds costs in fill prices, no isolated estimate.

evidence.snapshot_note: Derived from immutable in-memory copy of one atomic checkpoint; no writer lock or engine access. Journal prefix hash declared here, not re-audited by reporter.

publication_commit: Containing publication commit; resolve using git log -1 -- reports/usdcusdt/B10-reality-scoreboard.json

software_tests.scope: Explicit operator-supplied completed test-run evidence; not strategy success.

independent_audit.scope: Historical preliminary prefix only; not current or completed-run acceptance.
